as_told.title: Matthew Brown's tweet: White House has a proprietary AI that predicts future timelines

tellings.quote: As you now know, the @WhiteHouse  has long possessed a unique AI capable of accurately predicting a range of future events.

plain: The White House is said to have long had a unique artificial intelligence that can accurately predict future events. The Pentagon whistleblower Matthew Brown reads this on the show from his post on X, the social media site, of 6 June 2025, addressed to the businessman Elon Musk: "As you now know, the @WhiteHouse has long possessed a unique AI capable of accurately predicting a range of future events." In another episode Michels recalls the same post from memory as Brown saying the White House has "a crystal ball," a private AI that "predicts future timelines."
